metric_definitions.average_precision: Weighted mean of precisions at each threshold (sklearn.metrics.average_precision_score)
metric_definitions.pr_auc_trapezoidal: Trapezoidal area under the precision-recall curve (np.trapz)
metric_definitions.roc_auc: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve
metric_definitions.brier_score: Mean squared probability error against binary bust event
metric_definitions.bss_vs_e0: Brier Skill Score relative to climatology reference E0: 1 - (BS_V3 / BS_E0)
metric_definitions.bss_vs_e1b: Brier Skill Score relative to persistence/ensemble logistic reference E1b: 1 - (BS_V3 / BS_E1b)
metric_definitions.ece: Expected Calibration Error across 10 equal-width bins on [0, 1] with sample weighting

generalization_limits: Certified across 25 canonical synoptic stations in India only
Certified for 3 target variables: temperature_2m, wind_speed_10m, surface_pressure
Certified across 10 benchmark lead horizons (24h to 240h)
Evaluated on historical N=5 ensemble; operational live N=31 equivalence uncertified
Model estimates empirical forecast-bust probability, not severe weather, disaster risk, or general meteorological failure
